notes: Kuzo 0.2.14 (trial - not approved under PRO-AIC-0608 C1). Linking by hand on the trace: each file is a block on a strip from the datum - drag it back to back, into an overlap or away for a gap (it snaps to back to back and to a tape mark), flip it, or pick the same peak in both files and press Merge (peak-to-peak: not yet proven on two real recordings made with the 2 m overlap). The join view shows pass A above pass B on one scale; each pass has Kuzo's end-rise suggestion (now judged against the 3-13 m beside each end, within 3 m of it) and its own trims. Every move, merge, flip and trim is logged. New rope view: play along the rope, zoom in and out, a rope band coloured by LMA. Rope Record Checklist 1.7.0: no basic unit is not marked red; route 4, breaking force with its source and estimated delta-max are read; the installed-length check is a suggestion. Printed sheets numbered; threshold label shortened; time in a system dialog is not counted as a freeze; Run checks in a fixed group; older .slb ascending / descending suggestion.
